reviews.title: Terrible app
reviews.text: I used to have no problems accessing Chicago Tribune articles as part of my subscription service on my iPad. Recently, when I tried to access an article, I get a message saying this is for subscribers only even though I am a subscriber.. I login per their prompt, and even though it shows me logged in it refuses to let me read the article, stating that you need to be a subscriber to access.

reviews.title: New update has bugs
reviews.text: I like the new Navigation design but the articles view is very buggy. No headlines on articles and when iPad is in landscape view no text at all on most articles. Was this tested before you released it?

reviews.title: Harassing subscribers and Reid
reviews.text: I spent 30 minutes trying to track down two alerts. There was no obvious reason for them so I checked AI only to find out that the tribune wanted me to rate it. You flunked.

reviews.title: Doesn’t function properly
reviews.text: When I am in Newspaper view and click on an article at some point the article jumps to extremely large size, making it unreadable. The only solution is to close the article and reopen. Constantly! This has been the case for years and the Trib doesn’t bother to fix it. So frustrating!

reviews.title: Poor
reviews.text:
I received a notice about Covid money. 
I clicked and got the response that I could subscribe or log in. 
I logged in the article opened for a few seconds the. I was prompted to subscribe again or log in. Didn’t I just do that. 
Your system stinks, maybe that’s why young people don’t read the Trib. 
One of these days, unless your system begins to work properly, I may do the same. I have been a subscriber since 1966.

reviews.title: This App does not have in app cancellation feature
reviews.text: I had this app for over a year.  After a year the price was increased by 2000%.  You can only cancel on the phone within a certain window of times.  If you’re living overseas this is difficult.

reviews.title: Update failed.  Where’s the newspaper
reviews.text: The app was updated thru the App Store.  When I opened the updated app, a white screen.  I closed the app and reopened it with the same result.  Again, the same.  I then uninstalled the app and downloaded a new version from the App Store.  The same result.  C’mon guys, can’t you get this right?

reviews.title: International news
reviews.text: the current owners has dumbed down the paper. It is being run on the cheap.

reviews.title: Painful to navigate
reviews.text: Without a doubt this is the worst newspaper or magazine app. I suggest they start all over instead of fixing it.

reviews.title: Where’s the Beef
reviews.text: Not only has a once great newspaper become a shell of its former self, but non-stories often appear on the front page when front page stories get buried on inside pages. It’s very perplexing. I realize the Tribune has always been editorially conservative, but it is now touching on abandoning all reasonability and responsibility. I’m not sure why I continue subscribing. And the digital edition should be automatically included with any subscription.

reviews.title: Cannot read downloads unless connected!!???!!!
reviews.text: Finally made it so the newspaper editions are able to quickly download. However, unless app stays open, cannot access the downloaded version if not online connected! Dumbest thing ever!!! The point of downloading is to be able to access without requiring the connection else why download? Do better and find people that know how to test with real use cases.

reviews.title: Very hard to cancel subscription.
reviews.text: I’ve tried cancelling my subscription but this app keeps charging me and makes it hard to switch to free account and stop paying.

reviews.title: Running Left
reviews.text: What happened to the Trib’s smart conservative viewpoint. It’s now like all the others. Year in review photos was mostly “evil” ICE agents being mean to innocents.

reviews.title: Maybe the worst
reviews.text: Trib is dead, so the app matches the host.

reviews.title: Why did chicagotribune become garbage?
reviews.text: The website system has been experiencing issues, and subscription management is failing to load on different browsers. The news reports were superficial, and the journalists lacked professional competence.

reviews.title: Too Political
reviews.text: News is slanted and WOKE. Even political news is shown on the Obits page.

reviews.title: App is VERY sketchy.
reviews.text: I am a paid subscriber. I used the Chicago tribune on my computer. The app let me sign in, but then tells me I’ve used up all my free reading. Wants me to spend more money. I’ve tried everything and cannot login to this app.

reviews.title: Many bugs
reviews.text: Headline of today’s paper not showing up. Can’t get out of an article back to newspaper mode after reading. Some readability improvement won’t new font and layout but it doesn’t make up for all the other issues. New ones every update
